entries.subject: PCI DSS 4.0.1 requirement mapping
entries.reason: The E2.0 baseline has no confirmed scope decision that zdt-next directly stores, processes or transmits cardholder data. The profile therefore does not map PCI DSS requirements and does not claim either compliance or formal out-of-scope status.
review_conditions: Evidence that the system directly stores, processes or transmits cardholder data or sensitive authentication data.
A payment-channel or architecture change that may bring the environment into PCI DSS scope.
A scope determination requested by an acquirer, payment brand, QSA or other compliance-accepting entity.

entries.subject: Formal conformity to ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119
entries.reason: Only official public metadata and preview material were used. This is enough for a process-alignment profile but not for clause-by-clause formal conformity.
review_conditions: Authorized full text for each claimed applicable part is obtained.
A formal conformity claim is proposed and every requirement receives an applicability/tailoring record.

entries.subject: ISO 22301 BCMS conformity or certification
entries.reason: E2.0 uses continuity/recovery concepts only as reference alignment for selected technical experiments; it does not assess an organizational business continuity management system.
review_conditions: Ethan starts a separately scoped BCMS conformity or certification initiative.

entries.subject: Use of E2.0 as a runtime, merge, release or deployment gate
entries.reason: The product boundary makes E2.0 measurement, evidence and reporting only. FAIL/UNKNOWN cannot block or alter system operation.
review_conditions: Only an explicit future authorization from Ethan for one named item may create a separate mandatory gate; that gate would not be implied by E2.0.
